    }
    * { box-sizing: border-box; }
    body { margin: 0; min-width: 320px; color: var(--ink); background: var(--canvas); }
    button, textarea { font: inherit; letter-spacing: 0; }
    button { cursor: pointer; }
    .page { width: 100%; min-width: 0; min-height: 100vh; display: grid; grid-template-rows: auto minmax(0, 1fr); }
    .topbar {
      min-height: 64px; padding: 10px clamp(16px, 3vw, 32px); background: var(--nav); color: var(--ink);
      position: relative; min-width: 0; display: flex; gap: 16px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
    }
    .title { min-width: 0; flex: 1 1 320px; display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: center; }
    .brand-mark {
      width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 10px; flex: 0 0 auto;
      display: grid; place-items: center; background: var(--teal); color: #fff; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700;
    }
    .title strong { display: block; font-size: 16px; letter-spacing: -0.02em; }
    .title span { display: block; margin-top: 2px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); }
    .topbar-actions { min-width: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin-left: auto; }
    .status {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 28px; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px;
      font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; background: var(--teal-soft); color: var(--teal); white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .status::before { content: ""; width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #12b76a; }
    .release-center { position: relative; flex: 0 0 auto; }
    .release-bell {
      position: relative; width: 36px; height: 36px; padding: 0; border: 1px solid var(--line);
      border-radius: 10px; display: grid; place-items: center; background: #fff; color: #344054;
    }
    .release-bell:hover, .release-bell:focus-visible { background: #f8fafb; border-color: #cdd5dc; outline: none; }
    .release-bell svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
    .release-panel[hidden] { display: none; }
    .release-panel {
      position: absolute; z-index: 80; top: calc(100% + 10px); right: 0; width: min(440px, calc(100vw - 28px));
      max-height: min(650px, calc(100vh - 90px)); overflow: auto; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 14px;
      background: #fff; color: var(--ink); box-shadow: 0 18px 50px rgba(16,24,40,.12);
    }
    .release-panel::before {
      content: ""; position: absolute; top: -7px; right: 12px; width: 12px; height: 12px;
      border-left: 1px solid var(--line); border-top: 1px solid var(--line); background: #fff; transform: rotate(45deg);
    }
    .release-panel-head {
      position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 1; padding: 16px 16px 13px; display: flex; align-items: flex-start;
      justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); background: #fff;
    }
    .release-panel-head strong { display: block; font-size: 15px; }
    .release-panel-head span { display: block; margin-top: 3px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; }
    .release-close {
      width: 30px; height: 30px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: #f2f4f7;
      color: #475467; font-size: 20px; line-height: 1;
    }
